name: Brain Space Composer
description: Compose executable AI systems in Hugging Face Spaces

paragraphs: Compose intelligence you can see, test, alter, and ship.

Brain Space Composer is a visual laboratory for building executable AI systems. Arrange models, adapters, datasets, tools, memory, evaluators, training, model surgery, layer grafts, and existing Hugging Face Spaces as a typed graph. Then run the system, inspect what happened, compare variants, preserve its lineage, and publish it as a working Space.
features: Compose complete AI systems. Connect reusable components through typed inputs and outputs, from a simple prompt pipeline to a multimodal agent, benchmark harness, or training workflow.
Use existing work as components. Import callable Gradio Spaces, Hugging Face models, datasets, provider inference, and bounded public web tools.
Build systems with memory and environments. Compose working, episodic, semantic, checkpoint, and recall stages, or connect policies to interactive environments with explicit action and time budgets.
Train and evaluate visibly. Keep datasets, supervision, held-out evaluation, verifiers, training jobs, checkpoints, and resulting model revisions inside the system map.
Turn the graph into an app. Generate an interface from its inputs and outputs, download a runnable Docker/Gradio Space, or publish it to your Hugging Face account.

whatItDoes.text: Compose intelligence you can see, test, alter, and ship.

requirements.text: Hugging Face sign-in enables private resources, provider inference, Hub saves, Runs storage, and publication.
Publishing, public visibility, paid training, deletion, and destructive replacement require explicit confirmation.
